name: list_blocks
description: List library blocks (up to ~200) grouped by category: slug, name, tags. A broad menu; search_blocks ranks and filters. `categories` / `styles` arrays OR-match in one call.

style.description: One vibe; auto-set from the site's buildStyle.

name: get_style_reference
description: Styling and authoring reference. No `topic`: palette variables, styleGuide tokens, spatial scale, class rules, section skeleton. Pass `topic` for a focused guide: liquid (files, tags, filters, runtime data-* attributes, site JavaScript, forms, dates), design, accessibility, domains, blocks, editing, theme, pages, site, media, integrations, animation, collections, members, downloads, chat, redirects, emails; liquid-<lists|state|interactions|motion|forms|maps|data|sections>: one part of the liquid reference.

topic.description: Return one guide instead of the core reference.

name: generate_button_classes
description: Canonical button class string (DaisyUI btn + spatial CTA classes) from intent (variant, shape, size), plus the responsive CTA modifier class names. A starting point; extra classes can be appended.

responsive.description: Full width on mobile, auto on desktop (default true).

name: validate_button_classes
description: Check a button class string for variant conflicts and token misuse; optionally auto-fix it.

allowCustomClasses.description: false = hardcoded colors are errors, not warnings (default true).

name: list_presets
description: Curated theme presets (palette + fonts + tokens). compact: true returns id + name only. set_theme({ preset }) applies one.

name: set_theme
description: Write the site theme into theme.css (draft): preset, palette, darkPalette, styleGuide tokens (incl. spacingDensity, radii), fonts, typography (type scale), breakpoints. suggest_palettes / suggest_font_pairings only show options. Company fields: site.json (edit_site_file). Names, keys, workflow: get_style_reference({ topic: "theme" }).

preset.description: Preset slug; loads palette, fonts and styleGuide. Explicit params override it.

daisyui.description: DaisyUI component classes (btn, card…). Default on; HTML imports off.

palette.description: Complete palette — replaces the existing one. [{ name, color }] with DaisyUI names (Primary, Primary Content, Secondary, Accent, Neutral, Base 100/200/300, Base Content, …), never "Background"/"Foreground". Colors: hex, rgb, hsl or oklch().

darkPalette.description: Optional dark-mode palette with the same names. Enables dark mode.

styleGuide.description: Design tokens, merged into the existing styleGuide; each key becomes a CSS var (headingFontFamily, bodyFontFamily, radiusBox, buttonPadding, contentWidth, input*Color, …). Key list: get_style_reference({ topic: "theme" }).

fonts.description: Hint ({ url } or { families }) parsed into heading/body families when styleGuide omits them.

typography.description: Type scale tokens, merged by name over the ones fonts made: [{ name: "Heading", fontSize: "3rem", lineHeight: "1.1", letterSpacing: "-0.02em", fontWeight: "700", textTransform: "none" }]. Each field becomes --heading-font-size etc.; the `ph-heading` / `ph-body` classes read them.

name.description: Token name: Heading, Body, or your own.

breakpoints.description: Responsive widths in px for the whole site (sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl; Tailwind's are 640, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536): { md: 800, lg: 1100 }. What sm:/md:/lg: classes switch at, in the published site.

name: audit_seo
description: Score a page of the site's draft (or a stock template) for SEO: meta, heading hierarchy, alt text, link text, content depth. Returns fixes.

templateSlug.description: Template to audit instead of a site; pageId is then the page's url path, e.g. "/about".

name: list_templates
description: List stock templates. Filter by category, tag or q.

name: pull_template
description: Read a stock template's HTML + Liquid files (all, or one with path).

name: list_sites
description: List all sites belonging to the authenticated tenant (remote).

name: select_site
description: Set the active site for this session and clear any active template. Returns the site's settings and its previewUrl. The hosted server doesn't keep it between calls — still pass `id` on every call.

name: create_site
description: Create a site from a template (default "acme", the blank starter) and return its id, editor link and previewUrl. Then build it with the file tools.

name: update_site
description: Set the site's name (slug), title, description, ogImage, indexing, AI crawlers, timezone, language or mount origin/key — immediate, no publish. title/description/ogImage: fallbacks for pages without their own seo. timezone: the zone Liquid dates and {{ year }} render in. "" clears. Details: get_style_reference({ topic: "site" }).

name.description: URL slug (subdomain): lowercase letters, digits, hyphens.

crawlMode.description: public = indexed. noindex = viewable by link, kept out of search (a client copy not yet on its domain). private_preview = noindex + robots.txt Disallow.

blockAiCrawlers.description: true blocks AI crawlers in robots.txt and turns off /llms.txt; search engines unaffected.

timezone.description: The business's IANA zone, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles". Liquid dates (date, time_tag), {{ year }}, {{ site.timezone }} and the times in notification emails use it. "" = UTC.

mountOrigin.description: Origin of the Next.js app serving it via @pagehub/next, e.g. "https://app.example.com".

rotateMountKey.description: true issues a new mount key (shown once), voiding the old one.

name: publish_site
description: Publish the draft so it goes live. Every write is staged until this runs.

name: unpublish_site
description: Take the site offline.

name: duplicate_site
description: Copy a site you're a member of into a new site you own (content, title, description, portal, crawlPolicy). Domain and published state are not copied. The copy becomes active; the result has its editor link and previewUrl.

name: screenshot_site
description: Screenshot the DRAFT in a real browser (the preview, with the site's own JavaScript running) — the only way to see compiled CSS, theme, state-driven UI, scripts and responsive layout. Shoot sections with `selector` (full size, not scaled down), at the design width and at 390.

name: list_site_emails
description: List the site's transactional emails (receipt, welcome, gift card, sign-in link, downloads): customized or default, and whether each sends. Start here.

name: get_site_email
description: Read one site email: subject, preheader, Liquid source (emails/<kind>.liquid, or the default), its objects ({{ order.total }}…) and parts (keep required ones, e.g. the order.lines loop). Use simple blocks (div, p, h1-h3, a, img) with Tailwind; no forms, buttons, video or runtime data-* attributes. A link with bg-* is sent as a button.

name: update_site_email
description: Save a site email's subject, preheader and/or full Liquid source, or reset: true. Unknown objects, a missing required part and elements inboxes can't show are rejected. preview_site_email renders the result.

preheader.description: Inbox preview text, ≤200 chars; empty = default.

source.description: The whole Liquid source, as get_site_email returns it.

name: preview_site_email
description: Render the saved email with sample data: subject, errors (an email with errors sends the default instead), warnings, plain text.

name: get_domain_status
description: Read the site's custom domain: redirect mode, apex/www Vercel state, and the exact DNS records the user needs to create. `check` preflights another domain without changes.

name: check_domain
description: Preflight a candidate domain (apex + www): free, attached or erroring, plus the DNS records it would need. Changes nothing.

name: set_domain
description: Attach a custom domain (apex + www pair, or one subdomain) and return the DNS records to create, specific to this project. Doesn't publish; clear_domain detaches. 409 = a variant is on another Vercel project; 403 upgrade = plan domain limit. Details: get_style_reference({ topic: "domains" }).

domain.description: Apex or www form; both variants are registered. Detach with clear_domain.

name: clear_domain
description: Remove the custom domain from the active site. Detaches both apex and www variants from Vercel and resets redirectMode to none.

name: set_domain_redirect_mode
description: Switch the apex/www redirect pairing on an attached domain.

name: delete_site
description: Delete a site. Requires an explicit id.

name: invite_site_member
description: Invite someone to a site by email as owner, editor (default) or viewer. Owner-only. Re-inviting refreshes the link.

name: list_site_members
description: List a site's members with roles, and pending invites with their ids. Owner-only.

name: revoke_site_invite
description: Revoke a pending invite by id (from list_site_members). Owner-only; existing members stay.

name: upload_image
description: Upload an image to the site's media library. Returns a mediaId: write it as {{ '' | image_url: width: 800 }} (a URL) or {{ '' | image_url: width: 800 | image_tag: alt: '…' }} (an ; image_tag takes a URL, never a bare id). Web images: `imageUrl`. `dataBase64` has a ~3MB cap and is costly in tokens. More: get_style_reference({ topic: "media" }).

filePath.description: Local file path(s) — absolute, ~/ or cwd-relative; an array uploads many. Local stdio server only. Best for any file on disk at any size: bytes go straight to the CDN, EXIF-rotated, AVIF/HEIC → JPEG, downscaled past 2680px.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the ORIGINAL full-size image — no ?w= / h= / q= resize params.

dataBase64.description: Base64 of a real file's bytes, never base64 you write out (it arrives cut off). ~3MB cap; prefer imageUrl.

name: upload_file
description: Upload any plan-allowed file. Images go to the CDN; video/audio/pdf/zip go to R2. Returns a mediaId: {{ '<mediaId>' | file_url }} works in an <a href>, <video src>, <audio src> or a collection url/media field (images: {{ '<mediaId>' | image_url: width: 800 }}). Web files: `fileUrl`. `dataBase64` is a last resort (~3MB cap; pass mimeType for non-images).

filePath.description: Local file path(s); an array uploads many; type comes from the extension. Local stdio server only. Best for any file on disk at any size (video especially): bytes stream straight to Cloudflare / R2.

fileUrl.description: Public URL of the original file — no resize params.

dataBase64.description: Base64 of a real file's bytes, never base64 you write out (it arrives cut off). ~3MB cap; prefer imageUrl.

mimeType.description: Required with dataBase64 for non-images, e.g. video/mp4, application/pdf.

private.description: Store privately for set_download (any type; no public url). Needs filePath.

name: list_downloads
description: Site's hosted downloads: link, versions (★ = served), download count, plan allowance.

name: set_download
description: Host a file behind a stable link (<site>/api/downloads/<id>); link to it from an <a> or button. New: name + file. New version: downloadId + file (same link). Roll back: downloadId + currentVersionId. File = filePath (stdio) or an upload's mediaId (a public upload, e.g. a chat attachment, is moved private). access makes it members-only. A <video src="/api/downloads/<id>?inline=1"> plays it. Pro+; .exe/.dmg etc need Agency.

mediaId.description: An uploaded file's mediaId (upload_file or a chat attachment); not images.

access.description: Members-only: members true = any plan; plans = one of these. members false = public.

name: remove_download
description: Remove a download (link then 404s) or one non-current version; unused files are deleted.

name: list_membership_plans
description: Site's membership plans: slug, prices, access length, flags.

name: list_form_submissions
description: The site's form inbox (visitor answers), newest first: form, page, state, unread, answers, and each submission's webhook delivery (delivered / retrying / FAILED + HTTP status). With submissionId: one in full, with how the visitor arrived and its notes. Filter by state (default open), formName, q. Reading doesn't mark it read.

name: resend_form_webhook
description: Resend a submission's webhook from the start (attempts reset), to the form's current URL, signed with the current secret; same submissionId so receivers dedupe. For a FAILED or stuck delivery, after fixing the receiver or the URL. Owners only. Check the result with list_form_submissions({ submissionId }).

name: list_form_webhooks
description: The webhook URLs the forms on the PUBLISHED site post to (a {% form webhook: 'https://…' %} tag, live after publish_site), the forms using each, and whether each has a signing secret. Returns the `endpoint` key set_form_webhook_secret takes. Owners only.

name: set_form_webhook_secret
description: Rotate or set the secret that signs a form webhook (X-PageHub-Signature, HMAC-SHA256). rotate: PageHub makes a new one, shown ONCE: give it to the user for the receiver; the old one stops working. set: store the secret the receiver issued (16-256 chars, no spaces). `endpoint` from list_form_webhooks. Owners only.

name: set_membership_plan
description: Create (new slug) or edit a plan; only passed fields change. Slug is permanent; gate content in Liquid with customer.me | first, then me.plans['<slug>'] (get_style_reference members). Paid: stripePriceIds. Free: selfSignup. Pro+.

accessDays.description: One-time prices: days per purchase. Omit = lifetime.

selfSignup.description: Free plan; only with no prices.

name: list_members
description: Site customers with their plans, status and expiry. Filter by plan, status, q; paged.

name: set_member
description: add (email, plan?, sendInvite?), or grant/revoke/extend a plan, block/unblock, rename a member found by customerId or email. Applies on their next page load; never cancels Stripe billing.

name: remove_member
description: Delete a member (customerId or email); sign-in stops at once. Stripe billing continues.

name: find_image
description: Stock photos with verified, ready-to-use URLs (local bank, then Unsplash/Pexels).

category.description: hero/background = wide; avatar = faces; product = objects; team = groups.

name: find_video
description: Stock videos with direct MP4 URLs (Pexels) for <video> tags.

name: find_icon
description: Search every icon set; returns ranked refs for the `icon` filter: {{ 'tb/TbPhone' | icon }}. Tabler (tb) lacks many brand logos; brands come from fa / si / … and appear in the results.

kind.description: brand = logo sets; ui = Tabler only.

name: set_portal
description: Enable a portal UI around the published site (sales banner, client review, demo).

name: get_portal
description: Fetch the current portal configuration for a site.

name: remove_portal
description: Remove/disable the portal on a site (sets portal to null).

name: audit_accessibility
description: WCAG audit of a page of the site's draft (or a stock template): contrast, alt text, headings, ARIA, interactive elements. Returns violations by severity.

templateSlug.description: Template to audit instead of a site; pageId is then the page's url path, e.g. "/about".

name: search_blocks
description: Search the block library; returns one page of slugs with descriptions and tags (Liquid: get_block). Blocks are copy-source examples, not defaults. `q` takes short layout phrases ("split hero"), `categories` / `styles` arrays OR-filter, `page` pages through. Guide: get_style_reference({ topic: "blocks" }).

q.description: Short layout phrase, e.g. "photo hero"; sorts by relevance.

style.description: One vibe; auto-set from the site's buildStyle.

blockType.description: section (default) = page sections; component = patterns inside sections.

sort.description: popular | newest | name | relevance. Default: relevance with q, else newest.

name: get_block
description: Get a library block's Liquid by slug — a reference for writing your own section, not a default to place. Counts as a use.

name: apply_kit_block
description: Place a library block (`slug`) into a page file as a copy with fresh ids (pageId; before/after = exact text there; position 0 = top). To design a section for this business, write it with edit_site_file and use get_block as reference. Guide: get_style_reference({ topic: "blocks" }).

before.description: Exact page text to insert before.

after.description: Exact page text to insert after.

position.description: 0 = top of the page body (default: end).

name: delete_block
description: Delete a block you own from the library.

name: list_pages
description: List the site's pages: id, name, url, file, home/404 flags. Use it to get page ids. With pageId: that page's access policy (password set?, access conditions, deny action), body class and theme overrides.

name: add_page
description: Create a page: pages/<slug>.liquid plus its record (the first page is home). `text` is the page's HTML + Liquid. Returns the pageId. seo.title + seo.description can be set here. Guide: get_style_reference({ topic: "pages" }).

name.description: Display name; becomes the slug ("Our Services" → /our-services).

isHomePage.description: Make it the home page (unsets the current one).

name: update_page
description: Update a page record: name (changes the slug), SEO, home/404/hidden flags, pathPattern, and `policy`: a password, who may open it (access conditions and what a denied visitor gets), a body class, per-page CSS variable overrides. Head code and hiding the header/footer are edits to the page file. list_pages({ pageId }) shows a page's current policy. Takes effect for visitors on publish. Guide: get_style_reference({ topic: "pages" }).

isHomePage.description: Make it home (unsets the current one).

isHidden.description: Hidden pages aren't reachable by URL.

pathPattern.description: URL tail AFTER the page's own slug, for detail pages. Segments: literal or `:param`, no leading slash: `:slug` on page "Car" serves /car/<slug>. Read captures as `request.params.<name>`. Empty string clears.

policy.description: Page policy; each key merges, and "" or [] clears it. password: text (stored hashed, never shown back). access: condition groups, OR'd, [{ logic: "all"|"any", conditions: [{ type: "auth", key: "status", operator: "equals", value: "logged-in" }] }]. failAction + redirectUrl | fallbackPath: what a denied visitor gets. bodyClass: classes for <body>. themeOverrides: [{ varName: "primary", value: "oklch(...)" }] CSS variables for this page.

redirectUrl.description: Where to send a denied visitor (failAction redirect).

fallbackPath.description: Path of the page to show instead (failAction show-page), e.g. /login.

bodyClass.description: Extra classes on <body> for this page.

name: delete_page
description: Delete a page and its file. The last page can't be deleted; deleting home promotes the next page.

name: list_site_history
description: The site's version history, newest first: id, version, save/publish/restore, who (and via mcp/ai/editor), +added -removed ~changed, restorable. With revisionId: what changed in that version, file by file with line diffs (diff 'prev' = against the one before; path = one file in full). Read this before restore_site_revision.

revisionId.description: A revision id from the list: show what changed in it.

diff.description: With revisionId: 'prev' (default) or another revision id to compare against.

path.description: With revisionId: only this file's diff, in full.

name: restore_site_revision
description: Put a past version back into the DRAFT (never the live site; publish_site is separate). The current state is kept first (safety backup + a version in history), so it can be undone. scope 'site' (default) restores every file and page; 'page' one page (pageNodeId from list_site_history with revisionId). Unpublished work in the draft is replaced: confirm with the user first.

name: list_review_threads
description: Client review comments on the site: each pinned to a spot on the preview (the quoted text says where), with the conversation, author and status; counts of open/resolved. Filter by status or pageSlug. Clients leave them on the review link made in the dashboard's Review screen.

status.description: open, resolved or closed. Default all.

pageSlug.description: One page's slug; "" is the home page. Default every page.

name: reply_review_thread
description: Answer a review comment (body) and/or settle it (status resolved | closed | open). A reply emails the site's other owners and shows to the client on their link; it does not reopen a resolved comment. Make the change on the site first, then reply saying what you did.

name: list_site_files
description: HTML-first sites (format: html): every draft file (pages/*.liquid, partials/, sections/, theme.css, site.json, emails/, assets/*.js) and which page each serves. Format: get_style_reference({ topic: "liquid" }).

glob.description: Only paths matching, e.g. partials/*.liquid or **/*.css.

name: read_site_file
description: Read draft files of an HTML-first site, with versions. Read before you edit. `paths` reads up to 40 files in one call.

startLine.description: First line (1-based); with endLine for a slice of a long file.

name: search_site_files
description: Find text or a regex across draft files. Each hit is path:line:column plus the text around the match: copy oldText from it. `context` adds the lines around.

path.description: Only paths starting with this, e.g. pages/.

regex.description: query is a JavaScript regex, case-insensitive.

name: outline_page
description: Outline of a page of an HTML-first site: sections and headings with line ranges, and each {% render %} partial expanded in place, so you can place an edit without reading every file.

page.description: Page id, URL (/about) or file path.

name: edit_site_file
description: Change a site file by exact text: oldText once (or replaceAll) becomes newText, or newText goes insertAfter / insertBefore an anchor. Smallest span; keep data-edit-*. Linted on save; errors give the line, a missing oldText gets the closest match. The reply shows how stored text differs from what you sent. Stages in the draft.

insertAfter.description: Instead of oldText: anchor text (once in the file); newText goes right after it.

insertBefore.description: Instead of oldText: newText goes right before this anchor.

baseVersion.description: Version from read_site_file; refuses if the file changed since.

name: edit_site_files
description: Edit several files as ONE atomic write: per entry a path plus edits (as edit_site_file), or `text` to create a file. A new pages/<slug>.liquid also creates its page, so a page plus its nav link is one call. All land or none. Linted on save. Stages in the draft.

insertAfter.description: Instead of oldText: anchor text (once in the file); newText goes right after it.

insertBefore.description: Instead of oldText: newText goes right before this anchor.

baseVersion.description: Version from read_site_file; refuses if the file changed since.

text.description: A new file's whole text, instead of edits.

name.description: Name of the page a new pages/ file creates (default from the file name).

seo.description: SEO of that page, as add_page's seo.

name: write_site_file
description: Create or replace a whole file of an HTML-first site. Replacing needs baseVersion from read_site_file; prefer edit_site_file for changes. A new pages/<slug>.liquid also creates its page. A site's JavaScript is a file `assets/<name>.js` (lowercase, flat), linked with <script src="{{ 'name.js' | asset_url }}" defer></script>.

baseVersion.description: Omit only for a new file.

name: delete_site_file
description: Delete a partial, section or other non-page file of an HTML-first site (pages: delete_page).

name: list_components
description: HTML-first sites: reusable components (partials) and where each renders.

name: rename_component
description: HTML-first sites: rename a component; its file and every {% render %} of it follow.

name: delete_component
description: HTML-first sites: delete an unused component (refused while anything renders it).

name: suggest_palettes
description: Show 3 palette options for the user to pick from. Does NOT change the site; the chosen palette is applied separately with set_theme.

options.description: 3 options: { name, description, palette: 12 { name, color } — Primary, Primary Text, Secondary, Secondary Text, Accent, Accent Text, Neutral, Neutral Text, Background, Text, Alternate Background, Alternate Text }.

name: suggest_font_pairings
description: Show 3 font pairings (heading + body Google Fonts) for the user to pick from. Does NOT change the site; the chosen pairing is applied separately with set_theme.

options.description: 3 options: { name, description?, styleGuide: { headingFontFamily, bodyFontFamily, accentFontFamily?, radiusBox?, shadowStyle? }, palette? }.

name: set_favicon
description: Set or clear the site favicon. Exactly one source: `mediaId`, `imageUrl`, `svgContent` (user-supplied SVG), `dataBase64` (small icons, ~3MB cap), or `clear: true`. Best: a 512px square PNG or an SVG. Staged — publish to see it live. HTML-first: site.json. More: get_style_reference({ topic: "media" }).

filePath.description: Local file path (.png/.jpg/.webp/.gif/.svg; not .ico). Local stdio server only. Easiest for a file on disk at any size: bytes go straight to the CDN.

dataBase64.description: Base64 or data URL. Small icons only (~3MB cap).

svgContent.description: Raw SVG the user supplied (starts with <svg or <?xml). Never fabricate.

clear.description: Remove the favicon; other fields ignored.

name: set_integrations
description: Set analytics and verification ids, rendered as real tags on published pages: GA4, GTM, Search Console, Meta Pixel, Google Ads. Third-party snippets go in site.json inject; the site's own code is a <script>, {% javascript %} or assets/*.js file. Guide: get_style_reference({ topic: "integrations" }).

googleSearchConsole.description: Verification content value only, not the meta tag.

googleAds.description: AW-XXXXXXXXXX. Needed for per-action google-ads conversions.

name: set_redirects
description: Replace the site's 301/302 redirect rules, evaluated server-side before render. Paths are site-relative; destinations may be absolute URLs.

redirects.description: [{ from, to, permanent? }]. Pass the full list.

name: get_site_chat
description: Read the site's chat bot settings: on/off, assistant name, greeting, owner instructions, which details it asks visitors for, where leads go, and whether the owner has AI credits (no credits = bubble hidden).

name: set_site_chat
description: Change the site's chat bot settings; only the fields you pass change. Leads save to Form Submissions as "Chat". Visitors see it while the owner has credits.

assistantName.description: Name shown in the chat header.

instructions.description: Owner guidance: tone, what to push, what to avoid. Empty clears.

leadFields.description: Details to collect before saving a lead. Must include email or phone.

leadCollectionSlug.description: Also save each lead as a row in this collection. Empty stops.

notifyEmail.description: Extra address emailed for each lead. Empty stops.

dailyCreditCap.description: Credits per UTC day for all chats; 0 pauses chat. Omit for the plan default.

name: stripe_connect
description: Connect Stripe so the site can take payments. Returns the connection status and, while unfinished, a single-use onboarding URL that only the site owner can complete; the status reads 'ready' once they have, and that call fills the `products` collection from Stripe. Owner-only.

name: refresh_products
description: Sync the site's Stripe catalog into its `products` collection (creates it). Run after products change in Stripe. Returns the product count.

name: set_checkout
description: Make a collection sellable through Stripe (remove: true stops): `data-cart="add"` buttons inside a `{% for row in collections.<slug> %}` loop charge each row's `price` (minor units) or its Stripe price id (priceIdField). Needs stripe_connect. Details: get_style_reference({ topic: "integrations" }).

priceIdField.description: Row field holding a Stripe price id. Omit to charge `price`.

priceField.description: Row field with the display price.

variantsField.description: Row field with a variants array (each with its own priceId).

name: stripe_search_products
description: Search the site's live Stripe products (id, title, price, image, metadata).

query.description: Matches name/description; omit to list all.

sort.description: alpha | price_asc | price_desc | newest | oldest (applied client-side).

name: stripe_list_categories
description: Distinct metadata.category values in the site's Stripe catalog, with product counts and an image.

name: stripe_get_product
description: One Stripe product by id or metadata.slug: title, description, price(s), images, metadata.

id.description: Stripe product id (prod_…); wins over slug.

name: list_collections
description: List the site's collections (headless CMS): id, name, slug, row and field counts, public flag.

name: get_collection
description: Read one collection's definition (schema fields, source, isPublic). A webhook-feed collection also shows its ingest URL and how to sign a POST; its secret is never printed.

name: create_collection
description: Create a collection. schema = [{ key, label, type, required?, default?, help?, … }]; types: text, number, boolean, date, select, image, url, email, color, richText, media, json. Source defaults to manual. Plan-gated.

schema.description: Field definitions (shape in the tool description).

source.description: { type: 'manual' } (default) | airtable | csv-upload | google-sheet | webhook-feed | external-db.

isPublic.description: Visitors can read rows without auth.

name: update_collection_schema
description: Change a collection's fields or member gates. `schema` replaces all fields (get_collection first). `requiredPlans` gates every row. To lock single rows: add a text field keyed `requiredPlans`, write comma-separated plan slugs on those rows; non-members get them minus `memberFields`, with `locked: true`.

schema.description: Full field list; replaces the old one.

requiredPlans.description: Plan slugs whose members alone see the rows; [] clears.

name: delete_collection
description: Delete a collection and all its rows. No undo.

name: list_collection_rows
description: Page through a collection's rows: rows, nextCursor, hasMore, totalCount.

name: set_collection_webhook
description: Make a collection a webhook feed, or rotate / set its signing secret. Senders POST rows to the ingest URL (shown, with how to sign) and they upsert by externalId. rotate:true mints a new secret (shown once; the old stops working); secret uses the sender's own. Owner or agency. A collection syncing from Sheets/Airtable isn't converted. get_collection shows the URL.

rotate.description: Mint a new secret for an existing feed.

secret.description: The sender's own secret, 16-256 characters, no spaces.

name: create_collection_row
description: Create one row. `data` maps field key → value, validated against the schema. Plan-gated.

name: create_collection_rows
description: Insert up to 500 rows (field key → value) in one call, validated all-or-nothing (errors name the rowIndex). Plan-gated. Big CSVs: import_collection_csv.

name: update_collection_row
description: Partially update one row by rowId; omitted fields keep their values.

name: delete_collection_row
description: Delete one row from a collection by rowId.

name: import_collection_csv
description: Import rows from CSV text or an uploaded CSV/TSV/XLSX file (exactly one of csv | mediaId); header columns match field keys (unmatched ignored). mode: append (default), replace (deletes existing rows first), upsert (by an externalId or id column). ~8MB cap. Plan-gated.

csv.description: CSV text with a header row.

mediaId.description: An uploaded CSV/TSV/XLSX file's mediaId (the agent gets this for attached files). Use this instead of csv when the data was uploaded — never retype rows.

name: import_site
description: Turn a static HTML site (pages, CSS, JS, images) into a NEW editable PageHub site draft. Inputs, one per call: filePath (local folder or .zip; local server only); size (zip bytes) returns an upload URL, curl line and uploadKey; uploadKey, after the PUT, starts the import; files sends text files inline (≤3MB); restOf (an importId) brings the pages a plan's page limit left out into that import's same site, after an upgrade. Returns an importId for get_import_status.

filePath.description: Local folder or .zip. Local stdio server only.

size.description: Exact zip size in bytes → returns an upload URL.

uploadKey.description: From the size step, after the PUT succeeded → starts the import.

files.description: Inline files: path relative to the site root.

pages.description: Archive paths of the pages to import (e.g. about.html), when the plan's page limit can't take them all. The home page is always included; the limit still applies, in this order.

restOf.description: importId of a capped import: adds the pages it left out to that same site. Needs a plan that takes more pages (get_import_status says when).

name: get_import_status
description: Progress of an import_site run: status, page and media counts, warnings, redirects from the old page addresses, and the pages a plan's page limit left out with the next step to bring them in. When status is ready it includes the new site id, editor link and the site's previewUrl.

name: save_block
description: Save a new reusable block to the library from Liquid `source`. Use it after writing a section you want to reuse across templates. Library blocks carry no JavaScript (<script>, on* handlers and {% javascript %} are stripped); native HTML and data-* attributes only.

slug.description: URL-safe unique slug (e.g. "testimonial-card-stars"). Lowercase, hyphens only.

description.description: Short description of what the component is and when to use it.

visual.description: Detailed visual description for AI search — what it looks like when rendered.

subcategory.description: Subcategory within the category (e.g. "testimonials", "payment-forms", "product-cards"). Creates browsable groups.

preset.description: Starter / bundle id this block belongs to (e.g. "acme", "pagehub-library"). Use for attribution when extracting from a template or preset.

source.description: The block's Liquid (HTML + Liquid snippet). Read an existing one with get_block.

group.description: Logical grouping name (e.g. "acme-homepage-cards"). Use to batch related components.

style.description: Vibe this block belongs to. Blocks with the same vibe mix well together; the site's `buildStyle` filters the library to this value.

isPublic.description: Make this block visible to all users. Default: false (private to your tenant).

isCategoryPreview.description: Use this block as the representative preview/thumbnail for its category. Default: false.

name: update_block
description: Update a block: metadata (category, name, tags, description, newSlug) or replace its Liquid `source` (read it with get_block, edit, send it all back).

slug.description: Current slug of the block to update.

visual.description: New visual description for AI search.

category.description: Move to a different category (any string, no restrictions).

source.description: The block's Liquid (HTML + Liquid snippet). Read an existing one with get_block.

name: patch_block
description: Edit a library block's Liquid by exact-text replacement (oldText once, or replaceAll); `edits` covers several changes in one write. Like edit_site_file, for the library. Admin or tenant owner.

name: save_template
description: Create a template (admin or tenant owner/editor) from `files` (+ `pages`), or from a site's draft with `fromSite`. A template is the same files a site holds; sites made from it get a copy. Private unless an admin makes it public. Template files carry no JavaScript: <script>, on* handlers and {% javascript %} are stripped on save.

hidden.description: If true, hidden from public gallery. Default: false

isPublic.description: Visible to all users. Default: true

sortOrder.description: Catalog sort order (lower first; ties by title). Default: 0

files.description: The template's files: pages/*.liquid, partials/*.liquid, theme.css, site.json.

pages.description: Page rows { pageNodeId, sourcePath, displayName, pageSlug, isHomePage, is404Page, isHidden, pathPattern }. Omit to derive them from pages/*.liquid (index = home).

fromSite.description: Site id: copy that site's draft files and pages instead of sending files.

name: update_template
description: Update a template: metadata, files (merged, or `replace`), exact-text `edits` to files, page rows, or everything from a site (`fromSite`). Read it first with pull_template. Template files carry no JavaScript: <script>, on* handlers and {% javascript %} are stripped on save.

sortOrder.description: Catalog sort order (lower first; ties by title)

files.description: Files to add or replace by path (merged over the current ones); { path, delete: true } removes one.

edits.description: Exact-text edits per existing file, like edit_site_file: [{ path, edits: [{ oldText, newText }] }].

pages.description: Page rows { pageNodeId, sourcePath, displayName, pageSlug, isHomePage, is404Page, isHidden, pathPattern }. Omit to derive them from pages/*.liquid (index = home).

fromSite.description: Site id: replace the template's files and pages with that site's draft.

replace.description: With files: replace all files instead of merging.

name: publish_site_as_template
description: Snapshot a site's draft files and pages into a new template (slug defaults to the site's name). Template files carry no JavaScript: <script>, on* handlers and {% javascript %} are stripped on save.

slug.description: URL-safe unique slug for the template (defaults to site slug)

hidden.description: If true, hidden from public gallery

isPublic.description: Visible to all users. Default: true

sortOrder.description: Catalog sort order (lower first; ties by title). Default: 0

name: delete_template
description: Delete a template by slug (admin or its tenant owner).
